name: Ace Technologies Corp.
summary: Ace Technologies Corp., a company established in 1980 and headquartered in Incheon, South Korea, specializes in the global production and distribution of wireless communication devices. Its extensive product range includes various mobile network solutions such as base station antennas, antenna line devices, RRH filters, 5G technologies, RF systems, antennas for mobile devices, testing and measurement instruments, and cable assemblies. Additionally, the firm supplies antennas and radar systems for the automotive sector. For the defense industry, it provides communication and satellite antennas, RF modules and integrated systems, and radar equipment. The company, which was originally known as Ace Technology Corp., officially changed its name to Ace Technologies Corp. in March 2005.
